description: Single source of truth for the gateway's app roster. Consumed by build.sh, verify-deployment.sh, deploy-workers.sh, and the landing page. See D2-02 (wargame/w2/decisions/D2-02-deploy-topology-roster-manifest.md) for why this file exists. Adding an app means editing this file once, not six.

apps.title: No Cheat
apps.description: Detect loaded dice using computer vision and statistics. Point your camera, roll, and know.

apps.title: Versus
apps.description: Simulate 40K combat. Pick two units, see the math: expected wounds, model kills, distributions.

apps.title: List Builder
apps.description: Build army lists with live meta ratings from GT data. See what's winning before you build.

apps.title: Game Tracker
apps.description: Track matches turn by turn with photos, VP scoring, and unit losses. Your full game history.

apps.title: Tournament
apps.description: Run Swiss events: registration, pairings, results, live standings, and ELO ratings.

apps.title: New Meta
apps.description: 40K meta analytics: faction win rates, detachment stats, Glicko-2 player rankings.

apps.title: Data Import
apps.description: Load unit data from BSData into your browser. No account needed — data stays on your device.

apps.title: Admin
apps.description: Platform dashboard: user counts, active sessions, app usage stats, and system health.

apps.title: Brain
apps.description: 40K rules Q&A and search over the full core-rules + faction corpus, with a browsable knowledge graph.

apps.title: Study
apps.description: Search a folder of lecture slides by text and jump straight to the matching slide.

apps.title: Physics
apps.description: Search recorded lecture video by transcript text and jump straight to the matching moment.
